title: Kentucky Colonel and Distinguished Citizen of Louisville
summary: Louisville made her a Kentucky Colonel, a captain of the Southern Belle and a Distinguished Citizen. She did not know about it beforehand. She now stays at a hotel in Louisville but plans to go back and stay home.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards
